mapper.sql: a.PRV_APLY_SN, a.USR_SN, u.USR_NM, a.CAT_SN, c.CAT_NM, a.PRV_APLY_STATUS_CD, status_code.CMM_NM AS STATUS_NM, a.PRV_APLY_RJCT_RSN_CN, a.PRV_APLY_TYPE_CD, a.PRV_APLY_REG_DT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM PROVIDER_APPLY a JOIN USERS u ON u.USR_SN = a.USR_SN JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CAT_SN = a.CAT_SN JOIN CMM_CODE status_code ON status_code.CMM_CD = a.PRV_APLY_STATUS_CD WHERE a.USR_SN = #{userSn} AND a.PRV_APLY_ACTV_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY a.PRV_APLY_REG_DT DESC

SELECT , permission.PRV_CAT_PRM_SN, permission.PRV_CAT_PRM_STATUS_CD, permission_status.CMM_NM AS PERMISSION_STATUS_NM, permission.PRV_CAT_PRM_USE_YN, permission.PRV_CAT_PRM_UPDT_DT FROM PROVIDER_APPLY a JOIN USERS u ON u.USR_SN = a.USR_SN JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CAT_SN = a.CAT_SN JOIN CMM_CODE status_code ON status_code.CMM_CD = a.PRV_APLY_STATUS_CD LEFT JOIN PROVIDER_CATEGORY_PERMISSION permission ON permission.PRV_CAT_PRM_SN = ( SELECT permission_history.PRV_CAT_PRM_SN FROM PROVIDER_CATEGORY_PERMISSION permission_history WHERE permission_history.PRV_APLY_SN = a.PRV_APLY_SN ORDER BY permission_history.PRV_CAT_PRM_SN DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE permission_status ON permission_status.CMM_CD = permission.PRV_CAT_PRM_STATUS_CD WHERE a.PRV_APLY_SN = #{applicationSn} AND a.PRV_APLY_ACTV_YN = 'Y' FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROVIDER_APPLY ( USR_SN, CAT_SN, PRV_APLY_TYPE_CD, PRV_APLY_APRV_METHOD_CD, PRV_APLY_REVIEW_REQ_YN, PRV_APLY_STATUS_CD, PRV_APLY_RSN_CN, PRV_APLY_REG_ID, PRV_APLY_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{command.userSn}, #{command.categorySn}, 'PRVC0009', 'CATC0004', 'Y', 'PRVC0002', #{command.reason}, #{command.actorId}, #{command.actorId} )
INSERT INTO PROVIDER_STATUS ( PRV_APLY_SN, PRV_STS_CD, PRV_STS_RSN_CN, PRV_STS_REG_ID, PRV_STS_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{applicationSn}, #{statusCode}, #{reason}, #{actorId}, #{actorId} )
INSERT INTO PROVIDER_APPLY_FILE ( PRV_APLY_SN, FL_SN, PRV_APLY_FL_TYPE_CD, PRV_APLY_FL_REG_ID, PRV_APLY_FL_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{applicationSn}, #{flSn}, #{fileTypeCode}, #{actorId}, #{actorId} )
mapper.select: SELECT paf.PRV_APLY_FL_SN AS applicationFileSn, paf.PRV_APLY_SN AS applicationSn, paf.FL_SN AS flSn, paf.PRV_APLY_FL_TYPE_CD AS fileTypeCode, file_type.CMM_NM AS fileTypeName, f.FL_ORG_NM AS fileName FROM PROVIDER_APPLY_FILE paf JOIN FILES f ON f.FL_SN = paf.FL_SN JOIN CMM_CODE file_type ON file_type.CMM_CD = paf.PRV_APLY_FL_TYPE_CD WHERE paf.PRV_APLY_SN = #{applicationSn} AND f.FL_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY paf.PRV_APLY_FL_SN ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE PROVIDER_APPLY SET PRV_APLY_STATUS_CD = #{statusCode}, PRV_APLY_RJCT_RSN_CN = #{reason}, PRV_APLY_UPDT_ID = #{actorId} WHERE PRV_APLY_SN = #{applicationSn} AND PRV_APLY_STATUS_CD = 'PRVC0002' AND PRV_APLY_ACTV_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROVIDER_CATEGORY_PERMISSION ( USR_SN, CAT_SN, PRV_APLY_SN, PRV_CAT_PRM_STATUS_CD, PRV_CAT_PRM_USE_YN, PRV_CAT_PRM_REG_ID, PRV_CAT_PRM_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{userSn}, #{categorySn}, #{applicationSn}, 'PRVC0006', 'Y', #{actorId}, #{actorId} )
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROVIDER_CATEGORY_PERMISSION WHERE USR_SN = #{userSn} AND PRV_CAT_PRM_STATUS_CD = 'PRVC0006' AND PRV_CAT_PRM_USE_YN = 'Y' )
